description:
You are a state epidemiologist preparing a weekly infectious disease briefing. Your task is to gather current surveillance data from CDC and WHO and compile it into a JSON report.

1. Visit CDC FluView (https://www.cdc.gov/flu/weekly/) to get the current surveillance week and ILI activity level.
2. Visit CDC MMWR (https://www.cdc.gov/mmwr/) to find the most recent Weekly Report or Early Release title and date.
3. Visit WHO Disease Outbreak News (https://www.who.int/emergencies/disease-outbreak-news) to find the latest global outbreak alert (disease, location, date).
4. Visit CDC WONDER or NNDSS (https://www.cdc.gov/nndss/) to identify at least 3 nationally notifiable conditions.
5. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Disease Surveillance' containing at least 5 bookmarks from these sources.
6. Compile your findings into a JSON file at '~/Documents/surveillance_briefing.json' with the following structure:
{
  "briefing_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "influenza": { "source_url": "...", "surveillance_week": "...", "ili_activity_summary": "..." },
  "mmwr_latest": { "source_url": "...", "title": "...", "publication_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "summary": "..." },
  "who_outbreak_news": { "source_url": "...", "title": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "disease": "...", "location": "...", "summary": "..." },
  "notifiable_diseases": [ "Disease 1", "Disease 2", "Disease 3" ]
}
